name: Grilled Peanut Tofu over Rice Noodles with Cucumber & Radish Salad
instructions: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice one lime into a small bowl (reserve remaining lime for later use).
Peel and mince ginger; add to the bowl with the lime juice along with peanut butter, soy sauce, water, sugar, and spices. Whisk to combine the peanut sauce.

Cut the tofu planks in half, then cut each half into 2 triangles; return to the baking sheet. Pour half of the peanut sauce over the tofu, turn to coat, and set aside. (Set remaining sauce aside for serving.)
Once the water in the pot is boiling, remove from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes, or according to package directions, then drain in a colander and rinse under cold water; set aside.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add the tofu and cook, turning once, until golden brown and warmed through, 4-5 minutes. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, juice remaining lime into another medium bowl. Add oil, soy sauce, sugar, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, trim, and slice cucumbers crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and slice radishes into thin rounds; add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; pick mint leaves off the stems. Discard stems, roughly chop the leaves, and add to the bowl with the veggies. Toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide rice noodles, salad, and tofu between plates or bowls; drizzle reserved peanut sauce over the tofu. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
